name: Getsuei no Kusari -Kyouran Moratorium-
original_name: 月影の鎖 ―狂爛モラトリアム―
source:
The fandisc for Getsuei no Kusari, it adds a route for Ooigawa Mamoru
which continues from the normal end and after stories for the main cast.

The Vita port adds two entirely new characters Toudou Miyabi and Toudou Itsuki.
translation:
《月影之锁》的粉丝碟，新增大井川守的路线，承接普通结局，并收录主要角色的后日谈。

PS Vita 版新增了两名全新角色藤堂雅和藤堂树。
